seashell.a: Donald blows into the seashell like a horn to call Seabrisket.

scarf.q: The egg needs to stay somewhere soft and warm, like a nest. What could be used as a nest?
scarf.a: They wrap the egg in the scarf to keep it safe and warm.

cardboard tube.q: Goofy cannot make his voice loud enough to call Baby Red Bird. What Goofy could use to make his voice louder?
cardboard tube.a: Goofy speaks through the tube to make his voice louder and call the bird.

lampshade.q: The hot sunlight is making the egg too warm. What we could use to block the sunlight?
lampshade.a: They use the lampshade to block the sunlight and keep the egg from getting too hot.

ice cream scoop.q: A massive pile of non-melting snow blocks the train tracks. What we could use to dig?
ice cream scoop.a: A Giant Ice Cream Scoop could be used by Goofy and Donald to dig through the mound of snow.

blimpy blazer.q: A pony is in a high place. We need to help the pony to come down safely. What we could use it?
blimpy blazer.a: A blimpy blazer helps a pony float safely down from a high place.

windmill.q: Its a storm coming. What we could use to blow the storm?
windmill.a: The windmill Blows away the storm clouds threatening the farm

trash can.q: What we could use it to make music?
trash can.a: Is used to make music for the limbo game by beating on it like a drum.

penelope pony.q: Daisy needs to go the the Witchs Tower. What we could use it?
penelope pony.a: Carries Princess Daisy and her friends on their journey to the Witch’s Tower.

comb.q: The bridge is broken. What we could use to cross the river and reach the tower?
comb.a: Serves as a bridge across the bubbling moat so the friends can reach the tower

megaphone.q: The voice of Pete is not heard. What we could use to make it louder?
megaphone.a: Makes Witch Pete’s tiny voice louder after he accidentally shrinks himself with his shrinking potion.

bottle caps.q: Goofbot is missing his three control buttons. What we could use it?
bottle caps.a: The bottle caps are round and fit in place of the missing buttons, allowing Goofbot to work again.

shampoo.q: Goofy gets stuck in the gears. What we could use it to Makes the gears slippery?
shampoo.a: A bootle of shampoo could be used to makes the gears slippery so Goofy can slide free.

four shape wrenches.q: The bolts on the Handy-Dandy Machine are loose. What can we Used to tighten the bolts?
four shape wrenches.a: A pair of shape wrenches could be Used to tighten the bolts so the gears can turn.

buterfly net.q: Goofy is launched into the air by a spring. What we could use it to catch Goofy safely?
buterfly net.a: A buterfly net could be used to catch Goofy safely.

baby utensils.q: Baby goofy is hangry. What we could use to fed Baby goofy?
baby utensils.a: We could use the baby utensils to fed baby goofy.

sponge.q: Goofy accidentally spills punch all over the picnic area. What we could use to abserve the juice?
sponge.a: A sponge could help Goofy to clean the surface. It could soaks up the spilled punch and cleans up the mess.

party noisemakers.q: Goofy needs something to make a loud sound to start the race. What we could use to make noise?
party noisemakers.a: A Party noisemaker. They make the noise that signals the start of the obstacle course.

spring shoes.q: Goofy has to jump over a very tall pile of rubber duckies. What he could use?
spring shoes.a: A spring shoes. They help Goofy jump high enough to clear the pile.

space helmet.q: Goofy is distracted by the smell of Willie the Giant's Swiss cheese while crawling through the final obstacle. What we could use to block the smell?
space helmet.a: A space helmet. It blocks the smell so Goofy can crawl through without stopping to eat the cheese.

bycicle pump.q: Goofy gets stuck inside the trombone. What we could use it to Pumps air into the trombone?
bycicle pump.a: A bycicle pump. We could use it to Pumps air into the trombone to push Goofy out.

clothespin.q: Donald’s sheet music keeps blowing away. What we could use to holds the sheet of music?
clothespin.a: A clothespin could Holds the sheet music in place.

pitch pipe.q: Mickey’s ukulele string is out of tune. What we could use to Provide the correct pitch?
pitch pipe.a: A pitch pipe could Provides the correct pitch so Mickey can tune the string.

periscope.q: Goofy's hat is difficult to see/find from the ground. What Goofy could use to see?
periscope.a: A periscope. Helps them look into places that are difficult to see directly.

marshmallow.q: Goofy finds something that looks like his hat, but it is stuck. What we could use it to rescue it?
marshmallow.a: A marshmallow it could be Used as part of the search/rescue process.

hoppity ball.q: Goofy's hat is finally discovered in a high/inaccessible place. What Goofy could use to jump?
hoppity ball.a: A hoppity ball. Helps Goofy bounce up and retrieve the hat.

beach blanket.q: Daisy wants to have a picnic in the grass. What Daisy could use to sit in the grass?
beach blanket.a: A beach blanket could be useful.

pumpkin.q: We want to give a halloween party. What we could use to create a lantern for halloween?
pumpkin.a: A pumpkin could be great to cut and used for a lantern.

rubber duckies.q: The baby elephant needs to take a bath but doesn't want to get into the tub. What could make the bath fun?
rubber duckies.a: The duckies make bath time fun, so the elephant gets into the tub.

gong.q: They need to call all their friends to the carnival. What we could use to call it?
gong.a: The gong makes a loud sound that everyone can hear.

string.q: They need to know how much more corn is needed to fill the jar. What we could use to measure?
string.a: The string is used to measure the jar and find the halfway point.

parachute.q: All the corn accidentally turns into popcorn, and they need something large enough to hold it. What the could use it?
parachute.a: They turn the parachute upside down and use it as a giant bag to collect the popcorn.

pete pants.q: Pete’s pants are torn. What we could use it to replace?
pete pants.a: A pair of pete's pants used to replace Pete’s torn pants.

toothbrush.q: Pete has very dirty teeth. What we could use to clean Pete?
toothbrush.a: A giant toothbrush could be Used to clean Pete’s teeth.

motor home.q: Mickey and Minnie are going to camping. What the could use to travel?
motor home.a: A motor home is really good to go camping.

flag.q: Mickey and Minnie arrive to the camping and wants to decorate the venue. What they could use?
flag.a: A flag could be used to decorate the place.

paint brush.q: The place is neglected and needs painting. What Micky and Minnie could do to improve the place?
paint brush.a: The could use a paint brush to paint the place.

rubber duck.q: A baby didnt want to take a bath. What Minnie could use to make bath time fun?
rubber duck.a: Minnie can lend a rubber duck to make bath time fun.

cup.q: Mickey needs to make circles for his drawing. What Mickey could use it?
cup.a: A cup could be used as a guide to trace round shapes.

record player.q: Goofy needs something to spin the clay so he can make a pot. What Goofy could use it?
record player.a: A record player could be used as a makeshift pottery wheel because it spins around.

woodpecker.q: Mickey and Pluto’s tent falls over because the tent poles are different heights. What Mickey could use to cut the larger?
woodpecker.a: The woodpecker pecks the longer wooden pole until both poles are the same height.

metal pot.q: Willie the Giant is blocking the stream, preventing the fish from reaching Circle Lake.  What we could use it to make a loud bang?
metal pot.a: They bang the pot loudly like a drum to wake Willie and ask him to move his feet.

puppy bubble bath.q: Pluto’s bath has no bubbles. What we could use it?
puppy bubble bath.a: A puppy bubble bath adds bubbles to Pluto’s bath.

bath towel.q: Mickey and Pluto are floating toward sharp cactus needles. What we could use it to cover the cactus?
bath towel.a: A bath towel could covers the cactus needles so the bubbles can safely bounce off them.

kite.q: They need to send an invitation to Willie the Giant, who lives high in the clouds. What we could use it?
kite.a: They attach the invitation to the kite and fly it up to Willie.

gumballs.q: The Toon Car is out of gas. What we could use it?
gumballs.a: The gumballs are used to fill the gas tank; four gumballs are needed.

red rope.q: There is a tall wall blocking the way to Clarabelle’s bakery. What we could use it to climb the wall?
red rope.a: The long red rope allows them to climb over the wall.

mouseke mugs.q: They need to keep the hot chocolate warm while traveling up the mountain. What the could use?
mouseke mugs.a: The mugs carry the hot chocolate and keep it warm.

winter scarf.q: Mickey gets stuck in a snowbank. What we could use to pull Mickey?
winter scarf.a: The scarf coulb be used to pull Mickey out of the snow.

jingle bells.q: Pete's sleigh needs to announce that they are coming through the snow. What we could use to make sound?
jingle bells.a: The bells could be attached to the reindeer so everyone can hear the sleigh approaching.

wind up toy.q: They need to measure 15 Chip-and-Dale-sized steps to find the secret door. What they could use?
wind up toy.a: The toy drummer takes steps the same size as Chip and Dale, allowing them to count exactly 15 steps.

bouquet roses.q: A giant shoe smells terrible in the nursery rhyme “The Old Woman in the Shoe.” What we could use it to improve the smell?
bouquet roses.a: The roses are tossed into the shoe to make it smell better.

tennis racket and ball.q: A target is far away and they need to hit it to cross. What Minnie could use to reach the cross?
tennis racket and ball.a: Minnie hits the ball at the target, opening the way forward.

sand bucket and shovel.q: The Moon Men will only return Pluto’s ball if the group shows them a fun game. What we could use to build sand castles?
sand bucket and shovel.a: They use the sand bucket and shovel to build sand castles with the Moon Men.

secret spy googles.q: A wall blocks their path, and they cannot see a door. What google could Daisy use?
secret spy googles.a: Daisy's goggles reveal the invisible/secret door in the wall.

carpet.q: Its a great hole in the path. What Chase and Pluto could use it to cover it?
carpet.a: The red carpet could be use to cover the hole and continue the route.

vacuum cleaner.q: The wind has covered the circle of stones with sand, hiding the location of the treasure. What we could use to remove the sand?
vacuum cleaner.a: Mickey use the vacuum cleaner to remove the sand and uncover the circle of stones, revealing where the treasure is buried.

thermometer.q: The sand is extremely hot, and they need to find the coolest place for the luau. What we could use to measure the temperature?
thermometer.a: They use the thermometers to compare temperatures and find the cooler spot in the shade.

hand fan.q: Pluto is too hot after his fan is turned off. What we could use it to cool Pluto?
hand fan.a: The hand fan keeps Pluto cool without making a buzzing sound.

button.q: The locomotive's wheel breaks.  What we could use it as wheel?
button.a: A giant button could be used as a replacement wheel.

chase.q: Pluto needs help from an old friend. Who could help Pluto?
chase.a: Chase could be useful when Pluto needs help.

siren.q: The gang is flying through thick clouds, where people and aircraft cannot see them. What we could use to make loud sound?
siren.a: The siren warns others that they are coming.

ice cream cone.q: Captain Donald's boat has leaks and they need to cross the river. What Donald could use to cover the holes?
ice cream cone.a: Donald put the ice cream cones into the round holes to plug the leaks.

mirror.q: A giant toad is blocking the road. What we could use to move the toad?
mirror.a: The mirror attracts the toad because it becomes fascinated by its own reflection, allowing them to move it away.

colorful cards.q: Salty keeps mixing up the horns. How we could help Salty to follow the colors?
colorful cards.a: The cards mark each horn with a different color so Salty can play them in the correct order.

bag of flour.q: They need to connect the numbered dots on the grass to complete a giant picture. What we could use to connect the dots?
bag of flour.a: They pour flour from one number to the next, connecting all the dots.

monkey.q: They need to reach the top of a pole and open a treasure chest without tipping it over. What we could use it that climb?
monkey.a: The monkey climbs the pole and opens the treasure chest.

carton milk.q: Goofy needs to finish his recipe. What we could use to complete the chocolate milk?
carton milk.a: He has chocolate syrup, and the milk allows him to make chocolate milk, which they use to attract Cuckoo.

three balls.q: Clarabelle needs a yellow croquet ball to match her yellow mallet. What we could use it?
three balls.a: Clarabelle choose the yellow ball so they can play croquet.

baby rattle.q: A baby hippo is blocking the way.  What we could use to move the baby hippo?
baby rattle.a: The Baby Rattle distracts the baby hippo and gets it to move.

egg carton.q: The gang are going on an egg hunt . What could Keeps the eggs safe ?
egg carton.a: The empty egg carton could keeps the eggs safe.

skateboard.q: The eggs are rolling down the hill. What we could use to go fast?
skateboard.a: The skateboard helps Goofy catch the egg rolling down the hill.

bunch of carrots.q: Bunny Pete want to catch the eggs. What we could use to distracting him?
bunch of carrots.a: Slows down Funny Bunny Pete by distracting him with carrots.

playing cards.q: There is a fog in the lake. What we could use as fan?
playing cards.a: The playing cards could be used to fan the fog away at Star Lake so they can follow the trail of sparkling dust.

crystall ball.q: The path is blocked. What we could use it to knock down the crystals?
crystall ball.a: Used to knock down the crystals blocking the path through the Crystal Forest.

bunny.q: We need to go in the castle. What is Small enough to go through the tiny castle window?
bunny.a: The little bunny is small enough to go through the tiny castle window and open the door from inside.

silk scarf.q: We need the magic book. What we could use to hook the book?
silk scarf.a: The scarf could be used to hook Wizard Pete's magic book and pull it down.

stick chalk.q: We need to divide Clubhouse room. What we could use to mark the floor?
stick chalk.a: The stick chalk will be Used to divide the Clubhouse room into six equal sleeping spaces.

bed sheet.q: Willie the Giant’s finger was injured. What we could use as bandage?
bed sheet.a: The bed sheet could be used as a bandage for Willie the Giant’s injured pinky finger.

giant toolbox.q: There are a lot of rubber duckies on the road. What we could use to store it?
giant toolbox.a: A giant toolbox could be used to collect and store all the rubber duckies

tire pump.q: Its a lot of sand on the  road. What we could use to blow off?
tire pump.a: The tire pump could be used to blow off the sand off the road.

car seat.q: Chip and Dale are going to fall from the scooter. What we could use it to catch them?
car seat.a: The car seat could be used to catch Chip and Dale when they fall from their scooter.

tricycle.q: Pete lost his car. What Pete could use to return to the race?
tricycle.a: The tricycle could be used by Pete to return to the race.

cookie jar.q: We need to put the Daisy flowers in some jar. What we could use it?
cookie jar.a: The cookie jar could be used as flower vases for Daisy's flowers.

two hippos.q: The gang need to cross the creek. What the gang could use it?
two hippos.a: Two hippos could be used to hop across the creek.

kangaroo.q: Pete is far away. What could we use to go faster and catch up Pete?
kangaroo.a: The kangarroo Helps the gang hop much faster and catch up with Pete, who has Wilbur on his hat.

giant stick of celery.q: Pete is on top of the Shoe Garage. What we could use it to help Pete get safely down?
giant stick of celery.a: A giant stick of celery could be Used as a slide to help Pete get safely down from the Shoe Garage.

long ribbon.q: Pete need practice jumping. What we could use as rope?
long ribbon.a: A long ribbon could be Used as a jump rope so Pete can practice jumping rope.

ping pong paddles.q: We are in the boat and we dont have to move it. What we could use to oars to row the boat?
ping pong paddles.a: A pair of ping pong paddles could be used as oars to row the boat.

cowboy hat.q: The toy drummer is back down the mountain. What we could use it to catch it?
cowboy hat.a: The cowboy hat could be used to catch the toy drummer when he comes back down the mountain.

balloon with long string.q: We need to know in what direction the wind is blowing. What we could use to know in what direction?
balloon with long string.a: The ballon shows which direction the wind is blowing, helping them determine where the missing calendar pages went.

lump of clay.q: Donald is playing golf. He lost her ball. What we could use to make a golf ball?
lump of clay.a: A lump of clay could be useful to make a new golf ball for Donald, so he can finish his golf game.

microphone and speaker.q: Goofy need to be heard. What we could use to Goofy make loud?
microphone and speaker.a: A microphone and a speaker could be Used to make Goofy's song loud enough for the missing kitties to hear it.

gooey fish.q: We need to give a treat when the kities are found. What we could use it as treat?
gooey fish.a: The gooey fish could be Used to give the kitties a treat after they are found.

shoe boxes.q: We need to found a shoe for Goofy. What we could use it?
shoe boxes.a: The shoeboxes could sort the shoes so they can search through them for Goofy’s missing shoe.

vase.q: We need to carry water from the pool. What we could use it?
vase.a: The vase could be used to carry the babbly bubbly water from the Gurgling Pool back to Willie.

boxes.q: We need to order the room. What we could to sort and store the toys?
boxes.a: Used to sort and store the rubber duckies, building blocks, and stinky shoes.

flagpole.q: The switch of the Anywhere area is broken. What we could use it to replace?
flagpole.a: Used to replace the broken switch on the Anywhere Area and stop it from spinning.

hot dog.q: We need to attract the Martian Mickey’s pet. What we could use it?
hot dog.a: The hot dog could be used to lure out Martian Mickey’s pet cylinder from among Daisy’s vases.

tissue.q: Pluto has a cold. What can we use so Pluto can blow his nose?
tissue.a: The tissue could help Pluto blow his stuffed-up nose, so he can continue sniffing for the missing pet shapes.

jet shoes.q: The Martian Mickey’s pet cone is flying away. What we could use to catch it?
jet shoes.a: The Jet shoes could be used to fly after and catch Martian Mickey’s pet cone.

pots and pans.q: We need to call Jungle Pete’s elephant family. What we could use to make music?
pots and pans.a: The pots and pans could be used as drums to call Jungle Pete’s elephant family so they can take the group to the waterfall.

giant cookie.q: Donald found a space creature and its hungry. What we could use to feed him?
giant cookie.a: The giant cookie could be used to help feed the space creature they encounter during their journey.

big birdcage.q: We need to contain the space creature. What we could use it?
big birdcage.a: The big birdcage could be used to contain a space creature so the gang can continue their journey.

three colorful turtles.q: The group needs to cross a river. What they could use it?
three colorful turtles.a: They jump from one turtle's shell to another to cross the water.

super jet.q: Megamort captures Mickey aboard his zeppelin, and the heroes need a way to reach the airborne vehicle. What we could use it to reach the airborne?
super jet.a: The super-jet allows the heroes to fly up to the zeppelin and attempt to rescue Mickey.

tuba.q: Large rocks called the Dancing Stones block their path through Rocky Gulch. What we could use to make dance?
tuba.a: Donald plays the tuba. The music makes the stones rise into the air, allowing the gang to pass underneath.

music note.q: The heart pictogram indicates a tool associated with love or affection. What could we associate with love and affection?
music note.a: A music note. Music. We could associate love and affection with music.

miner helmet.q: The inside of the mysterious building is too dark for the gang to see. What we could use to iluminate?
miner helmet.a: They use the helmet’s light to illuminate the dark interior. Donald then finds a light switch, allowing them to see the room and discover more clues.

polka dot sock.q: Butch and Bella keep running around, making it difficult for Goofy to manage them. What goofy could use it to attract them?
polka dot sock.a: The polka-dot sock is used to stop the dogs from running, helping the gang regain control.

jar of fireflies.q: The lights do not work, and the paper lanterns need to be illuminated for Pluto's Pet Show. What we could use it to iluminate?
jar of fireflies.a: The gang uses the glowing fireflies to light up the paper lanterns, making the show ready to begin.

pink ribbon.q: Minnie needs a bow to complete her Cinderella-style transformation. What Minnie could use it?
pink ribbon.a: The pink ribbon is used to make a bow for Minnie.

hilda the hippo.q: The carriage is difficult to move because a wheel gets stuck. What we could use to move the carriage?
hilda the hippo.a: Hilda uses her strength to help push the carriage and free the wheel.

charm bracelet.q: The group needs to get through a locked gate. We need something to unlock the gate. What we could use it?
charm bracelet.a: The charm bracelet is used to unlock the gate.

heart shaped pillow.q: They need to catch the slipper safely. What we could use to catch safely?
heart shaped pillow.a: The heart-shaped pillow cushions the slipper as it falls.

two wooden spoons.q: Pete's drumsticks are broken, so he cannot keep playing the drums. What we could use to replace the drumsticks?
two wooden spoons.a: Pete uses the wooden spoons as replacement drumsticks and continues performing with his band.

comb and wax paper.q: Donald wants to play the kazoo with Goofy's band, but he has no kazoo. What we could use to create a kazoo?
comb and wax paper.a: The friends wrap wax paper around the comb. Donald hums against it to create a kazoo-like sound.

donald duck.q: Mickey and Minnie cannot figure out how to finish their new song. Who could help?
donald duck.a: Donald joins their band and sings the ending, completing the song. He discovers that his friends need him after all.

rescue truck.q: The group needs to fill a tub with water. Where they could have water?
rescue truck.a: They use the rescue truck to fill the tub.

glove balloon.q: The boys need help getting back down safely from a high place. What they could use to go to the high place?
glove balloon.a: They use the Glove Balloon to fly up and bring the boys back down.

fork.q: Pete gets tangled in underwater seaweed and cannot get free. What we could use to free Pete?
fork.a: Mickey and his friends use the giant fork to help get Pete out of the seaweed.

bowling pins.q: Pete needs objects to juggle. What we could use it?
bowling pins.a: The bowling pins give Pete the objects he needs to perform his juggling act.

traffic signal.q: The friends need to control the movement of fish in their path. What we could use to control?
traffic signal.a: They use the traffic signal to tell the fish when to stop and when to go.

spatula.q: A rubber duck needs to be lifted out of the water. What we could use it?
spatula.a: The giant spatula is used to lift the rubber duck.

oar.q: The gang needs something to strum the guitar strings. What they could use it?
oar.a: They use the oar like a giant guitar pick to strum the strings.

anchor and a rope.q: The gang needs to find its way out of a cavern. What they could use to leave a path?
anchor and a rope.a: They use the anchor and rope to leave a path through the cavern so they can find their way out.

concertina.q: Captain Goof-Beard’s treasure chest is stuck inside a castanet. What they could use to get the treasure chest out?
concertina.a: They use the concertina to get the treasure chest out of the castanet.

presents.q: Goofy is stranded on top of the Moo Mart and cannot get down. What he could stack to create a stairs and go down?
presents.a: Mickey and his friends stack the presents to create makeshift stairs, allowing Goofy to climb down safely.

party banner.q: Chip and Dale float away while holding too many balloons. What the gang could use to create a safety net?
party banner.a: The friends stretch the banner out like a safety net, allowing the chipmunks to release the balloons and land safely.

birthday party hat.q: Donald gets separated from his friends, and they cannot make their voices loud enough for him to hear them. What they could use to make a megaphone?
birthday party hat.a: They make a hole in the top of the party hat and use it like a megaphone to call Donald. He hears them, and they find him.

two red apples.q: The reindeer, Twinkle and Sprocket, are too shy to come over and pull the Go-Bow Buggy. What Minnie could offer as treats?
two red apples.a: Minnie and her friends offer them the apples as treats, encouraging the reindeer to come closer.

sled.q: Minnie, Millie, and Melody are stranded on a snowy mountain after the Glove Balloon floats away. They need to get down the mountain.  What they could use to go fast down?
sled.a: They use the sled to travel quickly down the snowy slope.

pink ice skate.q: A baby Yeti slides toward a frozen lake, and the ice is too slippery for the Yeti family to cross safely. What Minnie could use to glide across the ice?
pink ice skate.a: Minnie and the girls put on the ice skates and glide across the ice to rescue the baby Yeti and reunite it with its family.

strand of glow bows.q: The Bow Tree needs lights for the Winter Bow Show, but the friends have no lights available. What they could use to decorate the tree?
strand of glow bows.a: They decorate the tree with the glowing bows, illuminating it for the show.

doobell buzzer button.q: The friends need to get someone's attention while chasing the runaway Mousekeball. What they could use to make a loud sound?
doobell buzzer button.a: They use the buzzer to make a loud sound and attract attention.

bottle of dish soap.q: The friends need to make a slippery surface to help move the ball. What they could use to make slippery the surface?
bottle of dish soap.a: They use the dish soap to make the surface slippery so the ball can move.

purple pillowcase.q: The friends need a way to catch and contain the runaway ball. What they could use to catch the ball?
purple pillowcase.a: They use the pillowcase as a bag to catch the ball.
